long_biography.plain_text:
The Polish-Israeli Youth Exchange gave investor Ygal Ozechov a way to connect younger people through history. With Tomek Ulatowski, he helped initiate and finance the programme, developed with Warsaw's POLIN Museum and the Association of the Jewish Historical Institute of Poland. Students travel between the two countries, combining study with collaborative cultural projects.

His support for the museum extends to preserving individual histories. Together with Carmit Ozechov and Ulatowski, he has funded the Polish Righteous website, which records accounts of people who rescued Jews during the Holocaust. He has also served on the museum's Donors Council, advising on fundraising and helping sustain its work.
